targets.title: Targets per stage
targets.subtitle: Prefilled from the human agronomist protocol; editable. Element targets are shared with the planner.
targets.resetTitle: Reset the targets to the protocol?
targets.resetBody: Every stage target and element target covered by "{{name}}" is replaced with the protocol value. Your edits to those stages are lost.
targets.protocolPpmHint: Protocol {{recipe}} recipe diluted 1:{{ratio}} per tank ≈ EC {{ec}} mS/cm from the fertilizers alone (source water not included).
targets.ecCorrespond: These ppm ≈ EC {{fert}} mS/cm from the fertilizers + source water {{water}} = {{total}} mS/cm
targets.ecCorrespondNoWater: These ppm ≈ EC {{fert}} mS/cm from the fertilizers (source water EC not entered)
targets.ecMismatch: does not match the input EC target {{ec}}
targets.manualHint: Human · operator (person icon) = changed by hand; kept when the targets are scaled to the EC target unless you tick it.

scale.title: Scale element targets to EC {{ec}}?
scale.notPossibleTitle: Element targets cannot follow the EC target
scale.factorLine: Every element ×{{factor}}: the protocol {{recipe}} recipe at 1:{{design}} becomes ≈ 1:{{equiv}}.
scale.mathLine: Fertilizer EC {{fert}} = input EC target {{ec}} − source water {{water}} mS/cm; the protocol recipe at 1:{{design}} gives EC {{protocol}}.
scale.mathLineNoWater: Fertilizer EC {{fert}} = input EC target {{ec}} mS/cm (source water EC not entered, counted as 0); the protocol recipe at 1:{{design}} gives EC {{protocol}}.
scale.tableLabel: Element targets, now and after scaling
scale.manualHelp: Edited by hand and kept: {{elements}}. Tick “overwrite” to scale them too.
scale.ratiosNote: Target ppm (bold) with the min – max band. The element ratios stay the protocol’s; nothing changes until you press Apply.

reason.no_ec_target: The {{stage}} stage has no input EC target. Enter one first.

protocol.title: Human agronomist protocol
protocol.authoritative: Read-only baseline. The human agronomist stays authoritative; the AI advisor only gives a second opinion.
protocol.programTotal: {{minutes}} min per section ≈ {{ml}} mL per plant per day

history.title: Crop cycles
history.confirmBody: The current {{crop}} profile is closed and kept in the history. The new cycle starts with its own stage timeline and targets. Nothing in the fertigation system changes.

basis.configuredHint: No measured run in this period — calculated from the configured dosing ratio.

feed.drainNotMeasured: Not measured — no drain %, EC or pH in SenseHub.

elements.title: Delivered per element
elements.hint: Delivered = each tank's current recipe (ingredient analyses) × measured concentrate litres ÷ measured water litres. Source water and acid are not included.

ec.title: EC: recipe vs measured
ec.hint: The difference is source water + acid + analysis error; SenseHub does not measure the source water.
ec.method: Recipe EC = sum of cations {{cations}} meq/L ÷ 10 (anions {{anions}} meq/L).

feed.acid: Acid: {{seconds}} s valve time ≈ {{liters}} L (estimate, not metered).

vsProtocol.title: Tanks as mixed vs protocol recipe
vsProtocol.subtitle: Per 1000 L of stock; protocol {{recipe}} recipe for the current stage.
vsProtocol.hint: Protocol recipe ≈ EC {{protoEc}} mS/cm at 1:{{ratio}} and ≈ {{protoEcCfg}} mS/cm at the configured ratio (fertilizers only).

feed.recipeChanged: A tank recipe changed in this period (tank {{tanks}}): each run is counted with the recipe its tanks held when it started.

advisor.advisoryOnly: Advisory only. SenseHub never changes recipes, dose programs, dosing ratios, tanks or automations from this advice. The human agronomist's protocol stays authoritative; the AI gives a second opinion.

advisor.runningHelp: The advisor is working on a new second opinion; this page updates when it is done (about 1-2 minutes).

advisor.none: No advice yet. Run the advisor to get a second opinion on the fertilizer program.
advisor.keptGood: The last good advice is shown below.
advisor.confirmBody: This sends the crop profile, the calculated feed and the live fertigation data to the AI model and uses Anthropic API credits.
advisor.estimate: Estimated cost ≈ ${{usd}} (up to ${{high}}) with {{model}}, incl. Turkish and Arabic translations.
advisor.estimateFailed: The cost estimate is not available.

link.title: Dose controller link
link.subtitle: Should the fertigation dose controller follow this crop's stage targets? Every change is a proposal that an admin or operator approves; it applies at the start of the next dose cycle.

mode.followHint: Changes to the stage targets, the source water EC or the stage create a proposal. Nothing changes without approval.
mode.manualHint: The dose controller keeps its own settings. Nothing is proposed or changed.

water.missingDefault: Source water EC is blank on the crop profile, but the controller's EC fine-tuning assumes {{water}} mS/cm. That value is a SenseHub default written into the code on 2026-09-26 (closed-loop dosing, cd17586) — it was never measured. Enter the measured source water EC under Crop profile → Facts SenseHub cannot measure; until then the EC part of the link is blocked (the pH part still works).
water.missing: Source water EC is blank on the crop profile, but the controller's EC fine-tuning uses {{water}} mS/cm. Enter the measured source water EC on the crop profile — it is the one source of truth; until then the EC part of the link is blocked.
water.mismatch: Source water EC differs: crop profile {{profile}} mS/cm, controller EC fine-tuning {{trim}} mS/cm, EC range check {{raw}} mS/cm. The crop profile value is the one source of truth; approving the proposal makes the controller follow it.
water.defaultNote: The controller's {{water}} mS/cm is a SenseHub code default (2026-09-26, cd17586), never measured.

trim.title: EC fine-tuning (SEKO feed EC)
trim.explain: Adjusts all dilutions together once per cycle from the previous run's SEKO feed EC toward the EC target. It stays off until the SEKO EC has been checked against a handheld meter (within {{max}} %).
trim.enable: Enable EC fine-tuning (requires SEKO EC verified against a handheld meter)

check.enable: Enabled by {{who}} on {{at}}: handheld {{handheld}} vs SEKO {{seko}} mS/cm ({{dev}} %).
check.refused: Refused on {{at}} ({{who}}): handheld {{handheld}} vs SEKO {{seko}} mS/cm differ by {{dev}} %.

prov.trimCheck: Switched by the farm team with a recorded SEKO vs handheld check ({{who}}, {{at}}).

reason.ph_midpoint: Middle of the stage pH range {{min}}–{{max}}.
reason.ph_floor: Stage pH minimum {{min}} − {{offset}}, never below {{floorMin}}. Acid caps and sensor checks stay as they are.
reason.ec_ratio: EC target {{ec}} − source water {{water}} = {{fert}} mS/cm from fertilizers. The protocol recipe gives {{protocolEc}} mS/cm at 1:{{design}}, so ×{{factor}} → 1:{{ratio}} for every tank (all tanks draw equally).
reason.trim_water: Source water EC {{water}} mS/cm from the crop profile.
reason.raw_water: Source water EC {{water}} mS/cm from the crop profile.

fit.title: Element best fit with the current tank stock
fit.method: SenseHub: per-tank dilutions within the safe range that come closest to the stage element targets (weighted least squares on the relative error; weights from the element priority).

none.no_tanks: No nutrient tanks with a dilution.
none.no_element_targets: This stage has no element targets.
none.other: The best fit could not be calculated.

fit.explain: Different dilutions per tank (1:{{min}}–1:{{max}}) that would come closest to the element targets with the tanks as they are mixed now. The agronomy decision is equal draw from all tanks, so this is for information only.
fit.table: Element targets vs the best fit
fit.stockChange: Needs a stock recipe change (reachable {{min}}–{{max}} ppm)
fit.unreachable: Not reachable with the current stock at any dilution in range: {{elements}}. Needs a stock recipe change.
fit.compromised: Out of band even at the best fit: {{elements}}. The elements of one tank move together (e.g. Fe and the micros in tank D), so reaching all targets needs a stock recipe change.

dialog.followBody: From now on a change of the stage targets, the source water EC or the growth stage creates a proposal for the dose controller. The controller keeps its values until an admin or operator approves; approved changes apply at the start of the next dose cycle. These settings will follow the crop targets:
dialog.manualBody: The dose controller keeps its current settings; nothing changes on it. Open proposals (waiting or approved) are cancelled.
dialog.approveBody: These dose controller settings change at the START of the next dose cycle. A cycle that is running now keeps its values. EC fine-tuning is not switched.
dialog.rejectBody: The dose controller keeps its current settings. The same proposal is not raised again until the crop targets change.
dialog.trimOffBody: From the next dose cycle the dilutions stay at their base values (no correction from the SEKO feed EC).
dialog.trimOnBody: Take a feed sample during a run and measure it with a calibrated handheld EC meter; note the SEKO EC at the same moment. Both are recorded with your name. They must agree within {{max}} %. Fine-tuning starts with the next dose cycle.
dialog.seko: SEKO EC at the same moment

equalDraw.title: Equal draw
equalDraw.on: On — tolerance {{tol}} L / {{pct}} %, a tank failure {{policy}}
equalDraw.off: Off — each tank follows its own ratio
equalDraw.achieved_one: With equal draw every tank gets ≈1:{{ratio}} — the slowest tank's ratio in {{count}} recent run where its venturi was the limit.
equalDraw.achieved_other: With equal draw every tank gets ≈1:{{ratio}} — the slowest tank's ratio in {{count}} recent runs where its venturi was the limit.
equalDraw.unknown: No recent run was limited by a venturi: every ratio so far was reachable.
equalDraw.warnCurrent: The venturis cannot reach 1:{{ratio}} with equal draw: recent runs achieved ≈1:{{achieved}}. The EC target needs stronger stock solutions or larger venturis.
equalDraw.warnProposed: The proposed 1:{{ratio}} is beyond what the venturis deliver with equal draw (recent runs ≈1:{{achieved}}). The EC target needs stronger stock solutions or larger venturis.
equalDraw.basis: Measured: water ÷ litres of the slowest tank, median of the recent runs where its valve was open ≥ 90 %
